$schema_note: Registry of every app the factory manages. Workflows and tools read this file; humans edit it (e.g. paste the AppGallery Connect App ID after creating the app in the console, and the date in privacy_tags_configured after ticking the privacy tags from store/privacy-tags.md in the console; submit_for_review is refused while it is empty).

ios._note: iOS lane defaults. Apple locale codes differ from Huawei's (ar-SA vs ar, zh-Hans vs zh-CN, it vs it-IT, tr vs tr-TR); never reuse defaults.languages here.
ios._team_id_note: Apple Developer Team ID. Public (it appears in every provisioning profile and IPA), not a secret. Apps inherit it; an app entry may override team_id if it ever ships under a different team.
ios._decisions_note: bundle_id_prefix and the monetization rules below were decided by the owner on 2026-09-07. Every iOS app's bundle_id is com.proapps.<name>; monetization is real AdMob (banner + interstitial) plus a non-consumable remove-ads IAP, both enforced by check_ios_app.py.

APP_IPHONE_67._note: Largest iPhone set. Apple's screenshotDisplayType enum has no APP_IPHONE_69 -- it kept the APP_IPHONE_67 name and accepts 6.9-inch resolutions there. Apple scales this set down to every smaller iPhone, so it is the only required iPhone set.

APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129._note: 13-inch iPad. Required only when the spec's technical.devices includes iPad; Apple refuses to accept such a version for review without it, and demands nothing for an iPhone-only app. Apple's screenshot specifications give 2064x2752 for the 13-inch slot, and APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129 is the display type the console maps it to, even though the API docs still describe that type as 12.9-inch.

ios._copyright_note: Shown publicly on the App Store listing as '<year> <holder>'. Apple adds the (c) symbol itself, so it must not be in the value.

agc._note: AppGallery app-info fields the Publishing API can set, so they stop being console steps. Write them BEFORE the first submission: a PUT to app-info on a released app opens a draft version even when nothing changes (measured on habit-cue 2026-09-14, see docs/APPGALLERY_PUBLISHING.md).
agc._publish_country_note: 196 country codes, read back from habit-cue on 2026-09-14 -- the distribution the owner had already chosen by hand. Excludes RU and BY (AppGallery blocks settlement there for ad-monetised apps), CN (needs a China-capable entity) and US (no full AppGallery store). Comma-separated; 'OTHER' is allowed as a member but never on its own.

ml_kit._note: Needs HMS Core on the device, ML Kit enabled for the AGC project, and agconnect-services.json in the app module -- the file carries the routing without which every model query returns HTTP 405. The file is a credential: injected by CI from a secret, never in git. The ML Kit API key is read from it, so there is no second secret.

admob._note: Set as GitHub Actions repository variables, not here: factory rule 5 keeps ad unit IDs out of git. ADMOB_<SLUG>_APP_ID / _BANNER_UNIT_ID / _INTERSTITIAL_UNIT_ID, slug upper-cased with - as _. Workflows pass them in as FACTORY_VARS. Left empty so a pull request, which cannot read variables, falls back to the template's Google test IDs -- which is exactly what the quality gate expects on a PR.

iap._note: USA base price for the Remove Ads non-consumable; Apple equalises the other territories. asc_setup.py resolves it to a price point and creates the schedule.
